blocks.prompt: 16 (i) If \(a, b, c\) are in H.P., show that \(\frac{a - b}{b - c} = \frac{a}{c}\).
blocks.explanation:
Proof wala sawal. \(a, b, c\) H.P. mein hain, to darmiyani term \(b\) baqi do ka H.M. hai: \(b = \frac{2ac}{a + c}\).
Plan: \(b\) ki yeh value rakh kar \(a - b\) aur \(b - c\) alag alag nikalo, phir divide karo. Common factors kat jayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, b, c\) H.P. mein (\(a \ne c\), \(a + c \ne 0\)).
Saabit karna hai: \(\frac{a - b}{b - c} = \frac{a}{c}\).
Tareeqa: Har jagah \(b\) ki jagah \(\frac{2ac}{a + c}\) rakhenge. Is tarah poora sawal sirf \(a\) aur \(c\) mein aa jata hai.

\(a - b\) nikalein
\[a - b = a - \dfrac{2ac}{a + c}\]
\[= \dfrac{a^{2} + ac - 2ac}{a + c}\]
\[= \dfrac{a(a - c)}{a + c}\]
Kyun: \(a\) ko \(\frac{a(a + c)}{a + c}\) likh kar common denominator banaya. Upar \(a^{2} + ac - 2ac = a^{2} - ac\), jis mein \(a\) common hai.

\(b - c\) nikalein
\[b - c = \dfrac{2ac}{a + c} - c\]
\[= \dfrac{2ac - ac - c^{2}}{a + c}\]
\[= \dfrac{c(a - c)}{a + c}\]
Kyun: Isi tarah \(c = \frac{c(a + c)}{a + c} = \frac{ac + c^{2}}{a + c}\). Minus karte waqt dono terms ka sign badla. Upar \(ac - c^{2}\) mein \(c\) common.
Dhyan dein: \(-(ac + c^{2})\) mein \(c^{2}\) ka sign bhi minus hota hai.

Divide karein
\[\dfrac{a - b}{b - c} = \dfrac{a(a - c)}{c(a - c)}\]
\[= \dfrac{a}{c}\]
Kyun: Dono ke neeche \(a + c\) tha jo kat gaya, aur upar neeche \((a - c)\) bhi kat gaya (kyunke \(a \ne c\)). Bas \(\frac{a}{c}\) bacha.

Tasdeeq: \(a = 1, b = \frac{1}{2}, c = \frac{1}{3}\) (H.P., kyunke 1, 2, 3 A.P. hai):
\[\dfrac{1 - \frac{1}{2}}{\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{3}} = \dfrac{\frac{1}{2}}{\frac{1}{6}} = 3\]
\[\dfrac{a}{c} = \dfrac{1}{\frac{1}{3}} = 3 \;\checkmark\]

blocks.prompt: 16 (ii) If \(a, b, c\) are in H.P., show that \((a - c)^{2} = (a + c)(a - 2b + c)\).
blocks.explanation:
Phir wahi \(b = \frac{2ac}{a + c}\), jis ka matlab \(2b(a + c) = 4ac\).
Plan: right side ko \((a + c)^{2} - 2b(a + c)\) ki shakal mein likho, \(4ac\) rakho, aur perfect square \((a - c)^{2}\) bana do.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, b, c\) H.P. mein (\(a + c \ne 0\)).
Saabit karna hai: \((a - c)^{2} = (a + c)(a - 2b + c)\).
Tareeqa: Mushkil wali side (right side) se shuru karenge aur H.P. ki shart \(b(a + c) = 2ac\) use karenge. Proof mein aksar lambi side ko simplify kar ke chhoti tak laate hain.

Right side ko naye andaaz mein likhein
\[(a + c)(a - 2b + c)\]
\[= (a + c)\big[(a + c) - 2b\big]\]
\[= (a + c)^{2} - 2b(a + c)\]
Kyun: Bracket ke andar \(a\) aur \(c\) ko ek group bana diya. Ab \((a + c)\) ko andar dono hisson se multiply kiya.

H.P. ki shart lagayein
\[b = \dfrac{2ac}{a + c}\]
\[\Rightarrow 2b(a + c) = 4ac\]
Kyun: \(b(a + c) = 2ac\) cross-multiply se aata hai; dono taraf 2 se multiply kiya to \(4ac\).

Simplify karein
\[(a + c)^{2} - 4ac\]
\[= a^{2} + 2ac + c^{2} - 4ac\]
\[= a^{2} - 2ac + c^{2}\]
\[= (a - c)^{2}\]
Kyun: \((a + c)^{2} = a^{2} + 2ac + c^{2}\) ka formula, phir \(2ac - 4ac = -2ac\). Aakhir mein \(a^{2} - 2ac + c^{2}\) bilkul \((a - c)^{2}\) ka phailao hai.
Yaad rakhein: \((a + c)^{2} - 4ac = (a - c)^{2}\) ek bahut kaam ka identity hai.

Nateeja aur tasdeeq
\[(a + c)(a - 2b + c) = (a - c)^{2}\]
Tasdeeq \(a = 1, b = \frac{1}{2}, c = \frac{1}{3}\) se: left \(\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^{2} = \frac{4}{9}\); right \(\frac{4}{3}\left(1 - 1 + \frac{1}{3}\right) = \frac{4}{9}\) \(\checkmark\).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \((a - c)^{2} = (a + c)(a - 2b + c)\).
